title: Money Basics & History
subtitle: Discover the true functions of money and how currency evolved.

steps.content: Welcome to your financial journey! Have you ever wondered why green paper or numbers on a phone screen can buy you a sandwich?
steps.tip: Money only works because everyone agrees it holds value.

steps.title: The Evolution of Money
steps.content:
Thousands of years ago, people traded physical goods like wheat and cows (barter). But carrying five cows to buy a tent was exhausting!

Money was born as a universally accepted medium of exchange, a unit of account, and a store of value.
steps.highlight: Money solves the problem of needing a double coincidence of wants.

steps.question: What primary problem led humanity to transition from bartering goods to using money?
steps.hint: Think about what happens if you have wheat to trade, but the seller only wants cows. Money acts as a universal bridge for exchange.

options.text: The difficulty of matching mutual needs and carrying physical goods for trade
options.explanation: Barter requires both people to want what the other has. Money acts as a universal bridge.
Trade was never outlawed; people naturally evolved money for convenience.

options.text: Gold was too abundant and lost its value
options.explanation: Gold was chosen because it was scarce, durable, and easily recognizable.

steps.content: To be good money, an asset must also preserve your purchasing power over time so you can spend it next month or next year.
steps.tip: Inflation slowly erodes how much a dollar can buy.

steps.question: Which core function of money allows you to save purchasing power today and spend it years later?
steps.hint: Consider which function lets you reliably store and preserve the purchasing power of your work for future use.

options.explanation: Store of value ensures that money earned today can reliably buy goods in the future.
Medium of exchange refers to using money for immediate transactions.
Unit of account is the pricing measure for comparison.

steps.title: Money Basics Mastered
steps.content: You learned the three superpowers of money: medium of exchange, store of value, and unit of account.
